title: Grilled Satay Tempeh with Spicy Malaysian Peanut Sauce
description: A Thai-inspired dish featuring marinated tempeh grilled to perfection and served with a spicy peanut sauce. Crispy and jagged vegetables add a satisfying crunch to each bite.

ingredients.name: Jagged vegetables (such as bell peppers, carrots, and onions)

instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together vegetable oil, Thai red curry paste, and coconut milk. Add tempeh and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
3. Remove tempeh from marinade and grill for 3-4 minutes per side, or until slightly charred.
4. Meanwhile, heat Malaysian peanut sauce in a small saucepan over low heat.
5. Grill jagged vegetables for 2-3 minutes per side, or until slightly tender.
6. Serve grilled tempeh with spicy peanut sauce and crispy satay on the side.
7. Garnish with chopped cilantro and sesame seeds, if desired.
